 description vers-r5

 neighbor 172.16.34.1 ttl-security hops 1

  network 10.2.0.0/16
  network 192.168.2.0/24
  neighbor 172.16.34.1 maximum-prefix 10
  neighbor 172.16.34.1 route-map RM-EBGP-IN in
  neighbor 172.16.34.1 route-map RM-EBGP-OUT out

exit

 ospf router-id 10.2.255.4

exit
